name: Kuon
source:
Her words and actions are utterly indecipherable at first meeting—mysterious and bewitching, leaving you unsure if she's joking or serious.

One moment she'll suddenly close the distance, the next she'll drift away, leaving behind cryptic words.
It's as if she's testing you. That very elusiveness is her charm.

[From the [url=https://qureate.co.jp/bunnygarden2/en/]official website[/url]]
